tools.name: kata_search_research
tools.description: Search live scholarly works through OpenAlex. Returns normalized real research records; never mock data.

tools.name: kata_plan_triage
tools.description: Create a deterministic triage plan from live OpenAlex results or supplied works without mutating a workspace.

tools.name: kata_diagnose_web_interop
tools.description: Classify observed WebMCP, browser and API constraints and return a conservative compliant integration path without weakening security controls.

tools.name: kata_apply_command
tools.description: Apply one allowlisted semantic workspace command and return the next workspace snapshot.

tools.name: kata_compile_workflow
tools.description: Compile two compatible semantic demonstrations into a deterministic JSON-Schema-constrained program.

tools.name: kata_execute_program
tools.description: Execute a compiled deterministic program transactionally against a supplied workspace snapshot.

tools.name: kata_preview_automation
tools.description: Preview an automation and return matching works plus an integrity fingerprint. Makes no changes.

tools.name: kata_run_automation
tools.description: Run a deterministic automation only when its preview fingerprint still matches current inputs. Nested tools are depth-bounded.
